mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_daily_score ( user_id, date, score, grade, feedback, daily_kcal, total_kcal ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{date}, #{score}, #{grade}, #{feedback}, #{dailyKcal}, #{totalKcal} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), grade = VALUES(grade), feedback = VALUES(feedback), daily_kcal = VALUES(daily_kcal), total_kcal = VALUES(total_kcal), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
